recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It is a narrow source correction to an active package-spec page; any separate XML package documentation should be handled by a future work-group decision rather than expanded under this issue.
issue_request: FHIR-27832 asked the Published/Persuasive FHIR-core package specification to clarify that examples, when present, are JSON and that additional package folders are subfolders of the package folder rather than siblings.
initial_application: Commit b270ad0998373820b9f6c195ce3fa39e3dc318a6 applied the issue by adding JSON example-folder and subfolder wording to source/packages.html, but left the main structure bullet saying an examples folder while the same page and current packages use /package/example.
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml includes packages.html in the current build. FHIR-I minutes recorded the issue as a technical correction for JSON package documentation, with XML package documentation noted as separate future work. Current package tarballs and a 2024 implementer discussion corroborate package/example for IG examples.
reconciliation: Changed source/packages.html to explicitly say the example folder is /package/example and to state that additional folders and files are below the package folder, preserving the Jira-requested JSON guidance while removing the remaining inconsistency.
source_changes: source/packages.html: clarified the JSON example resource folder as /package/example and clarified that additional folders and files are below the package folder.
